answers.reply:
Green roofs keep Chicago's roofs much cooler in summer: on hot afternoons Chicago City Hall's green roof measured up to 50 degrees F cooler than the tar roof of the county building next door, and the US EPA says green roof surfaces can be 30 to 40 degrees F cooler than conventional roofs.

The notes are on the canvas: a yellow Question note with your question, then a green note for each of the two findings, each with its source.
